llm.summary: The skill's behavior (controlling a Venus/Cachito vibrator via a local macOS BLE bridge) matches its description, but the runtime instructions require cloning and running third‑party code and granting Bluetooth/system permissions — which is risky and should be audited before use.

dimensions.detail: Name/description align with the instructions: the skill expects a local HTTP bridge on macOS that broadcasts BLE commands to a Venus/Cachito device. The documented steps (sniff device id, run server, call local endpoints) are coherent for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs the user/agent to git clone an external GitHub repository and run Python scripts (sniff_cachito.py, server.py) and to edit ble_worker.py. Those steps go beyond simple API calls and involve executing third‑party code, changing files, and granting Bluetooth access. The agent is also told to run shell curl commands against a local server and to avoid using a specific tool, which gives implementation-specific execution instructions rather than a pure API description.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no formal install spec, but the runtime instructions direct cloning and running a personal GitHub repo (https://github.com/AmandaClarke61/toybrige). Instructing users/agents to fetch and execute unverified code from a personal repo is high risk. The repo URL appears to be a personal fork (and possibly misspelled as 'toybrige'), so the origin and integrity are unclear.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request environment variables, credentials, or config paths beyond requiring macOS Bluetooth permissions and a local server. Requesting Bluetooth permissions and a device pairing ID is proportional to the stated purpose. However, running arbitrary code that has access to Bluetooth and local network sockets increases the privilege/impact of those permissions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated platform privileges in the manifest. It does instruct running a long‑lived local server (port 8888) but does not indicate modifying other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or following these instructions: 1) Do not blindly run git clone and python scripts from an unverified personal GitHub repo — inspect the repository contents and confirm it does only what you expect. 2) Audit the server code to ensure it binds to localhost only and does not exfiltrate data or open external access. 3) Run the bridge in an isolated account/container if possible; avoid running as admin. 4) Be aware this grants code access to your Mac's Bluetooth and can control a physical device — ensure consent and privacy considerations. 5) If you are uncomfortable auditing code yourself, ask a trusted developer to review the repo or avoid installing.
llm.findings: [no_code_files_to_scan] expected: The static scanner found no code files to analyze because this is instruction-only. The security surface is the SKILL.md instructions (which request cloning/executing external code).
